{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Return all entities and sub-layer in [[Eden Entity]] layer. In order to get all layer entities during a scenario use [[getMissionLayerEntities]].

|s1= [[get3DENLayerEntities]] layerID

|p1= layerID: [[Number]] - layer ID as returned by [[add3DENLayer]] command

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Eden Entity|Eden Entities]]

|x1= <sqf>
_myLayer = -1 add3DENLayer "CTRG";
player set3DENLayer _myLayer;
_entities = get3DENLayerEntities _myLayer;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[add3DENLayer]] [[remove3DENLayer]] [[set3DENLayer]] [[getMissionLayerEntities]] [[getMissionLayers]]
}}
